## a caller can turn off the link preview

ID: `feedback-loop-notices/a-caller-can-turn-off-the-link-preview`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`notify.py` `push()` SHALL accept `no_preview`; when it is true the `sendMessage` body SHALL carry `disable_web_page_preview: true`, and when it is false (the default) the body SHALL be unchanged. A delivered result SHALL also carry the `message_id`. An HTTP error result SHALL carry Telegram's `description` with the token removed.

Implemented by:

- `learning_loop.notify.push` — [`scripts/learning_loop/notify.py:57`](../../scripts/learning_loop/notify.py#L57)

## a message counts as sent only on telegram acceptance

ID: `feedback-loop-notices/a-message-counts-as-sent-only-on-telegram-acceptance`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`notify.py` SHALL send one Telegram `sendMessage` (plain text) and report it delivered only when Telegram answers HTTP 200 with `ok` true and a `message_id`. It SHALL NOT call `getUpdates` or `deleteWebhook`, because the bot's webhook belongs to another service. With the token or chat id missing, or on any network error or other answer, it SHALL report not delivered, exit non-zero and never raise. It SHALL NOT print the token or chat id.

Implemented by:

- `learning_loop.notify` — [`scripts/learning_loop/notify.py:1`](../../scripts/learning_loop/notify.py#L1)

## loop failures are concerns

ID: `feedback-loop-notices/loop-failures-are-concerns`

Status: **implemented and tested**

When a loop script fails (weekly problems, nightly collector, fix owner) or the policy check finds unregistered rules, it SHALL open or update a keyed concern through `scripts/concern_issue.py` and SHALL NOT call a Project Meta script.

Implemented by:

- `learning_loop.alert` — [`scripts/learning_loop/alert.py:1`](../../scripts/learning_loop/alert.py#L1)

- Scenario `loop-failures-are-concerns`: tested by `tests/test_feedback_loop_notices.py::test_file_alert_runs_the_aes_concern_adapter` ([`tests/test_feedback_loop_notices.py:99`](../../tests/test_feedback_loop_notices.py#L99))

## the loop runs without project meta

ID: `feedback-loop-notices/the-loop-runs-without-project-meta`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The feedback loop scripts that file concerns or send notices (`problems.py`, `label_items.py`, `fix_owner.py`, `policies.py`, `alert.py`, `notify.py`; `collect_feedback.py` for notices only) SHALL call only the concern adapter `scripts/concern_issue.py` and the push sender `scripts/learning_loop/notify.py` from this repository. They SHALL NOT call any script under a Project Meta checkout.

Implemented by:

- `learning_loop.problems` — [`scripts/learning_loop/problems.py:1`](../../scripts/learning_loop/problems.py#L1)

- Scenario `no-project-meta-path`: tested by `tests/test_feedback_loop_notices.py::test_loop_scripts_call_no_project_meta_script` ([`tests/test_feedback_loop_notices.py:88`](../../tests/test_feedback_loop_notices.py#L88))
